lines.text: Formation! Just like we drilled it.
Stay close and watch each other's backs.
Here they come. Together, on my mark!
Finally! I've been itching for a real fight!
Eyes forward. Nobody charges without a signal.
I'm right behind you. I think. Yes. Right behind you.
Over here! Try me instead!
Is that all? We've had harder mornings at training.
Hey! Leave my teammate alone!
Yoo-hoo! Missed me! Missed me again!
I'm hit! Cover me a moment!
Running low. Don't wait for me!
Still standing. Barely. Keep going!
This is nothing. I've had worse from a sparring dummy.
They're down! Someone get to them!
Guard them! I'll draw the attack!
Hang on, we're coming for you!
Nobody touches them again. Nobody.
Sorry... keep going...
Go on... don't worry about me...
That one... got me...
They're giving up! Hold your strikes!
Stand down! They yielded!
Fall back! There are too many!
Back to the trees! Now!
Retreat! We regroup at the stream!
We did it! Everyone all right?
Good work. Check your tools and catch your breath.
Ha! That's teamwork!
Everyone in one piece? Good. Here, have a rice ball.
Kunai collected: all but two. We'll find those before we leave.
We'll get them next time. Help me up.
That didn't go to plan. We'll talk it through.
Everyone breathing? Then we can still fix this.
Caught it! Your turn!
Blocked! Hit them now!
Ha! Opening!
They read me! Careful!
Bounced right off. They're good.
Argh, too obvious.
That's the chain!
Down! Nice set-up!
Got them clean!
{technique}! Clear the way!
Covering you! {technique}!
Step aside! {technique}, now!
They stopped it! Watch out!
My jutsu didn't take. Plan B!
Countered. They know what they're doing.
Something's wrong. The trees keep moving.
Is that you? Say something only you would say.
I can't tell what's real!
Release! I'm back. Thanks.
Snapped out of it! Where are they?
Clear head again. Let's go.
Smoke! Use it, move!
They can't see us. Go quiet, go now!
Into the smoke. Flank them!
A log! They swapped out!
Behind you! That was a substitution!
Gone! Watch the trees!
On it!
Going in!
Right behind you. Attack!
Understood. Hitting the one on the left.
Yes! Finally!
Guarding!
I'll hold them off. Go!
Shields up. Nobody gets past me.
Defending. Call if you need me.
Right with you.
Following your lead.
Lead the way. I'm close.
Stay in sight. I'm on your heels.
Holding here.
Not moving. Promise.
Staying put. Say the word.
Holding position. Eyes open.
Hold? Ugh. Fine. But not for long!
Ready when you are!
Combo! On three!
Let's put it together!
Set them up. I'll finish!
Now! Together!
Hit them high, I'll go low!
Your strike, then mine! Go!
Push them to me! I've got the finish!
Same time! Three, two, one!
Your {nature} and mine together! Now!
Add your jutsu to mine! It'll double!
Fire on wind! Make it roar!
Water first, then lightning! Trust me!
Let's mix our chakra. On my signal!
Hold still. This will sting a little.
There. That should close it up.
Breathe. You're all right. Back in it.
Here, a soldier pill and a bandage. Go!
Patched you up. Try not to get hit there again.
Finally. Just you and me.
I've been waiting for this. No excuses afterwards.
Let's settle it. Here, now.
That's it? I expected more from you.
You're slower than last time.
Try to keep up, will you?
Not bad... but I'm not done.
This doesn't mean anything!
I won't lose to you. Not to you.
Next time... I'll win...
You got lucky. Remember that.
Fine. Fine! This round's yours.
I'm stopping. Not because you won. I'm stopping.
This isn't over. Not even close.
I'll finish this when it counts.
Told you. I'm ahead.
Get up. That's one more for me.
Train harder. I'll be waiting.
You won. Don't let it go to your head.
Hmph. I'll be twice as good next time.
Again. Tomorrow. Same place.
Predictable. I know all your habits.
I've watched you train. I knew that was coming.
You... read that?
Tch. Since when can you do that?
Feel that? That's the difference between us.
Clean. Like I practised.
{technique}. Learned it before you, of course.
I mastered {technique} first. Watch and weep.
{technique}! Don't blink.
You countered it? Who taught you that?
That won't work twice. Neither will your counter.
Stop it. This is a trick. I know it's a trick.
You're using illusions now? Coward's way out.
Broken. Is that all you've got?
Release. Pathetic illusion.
Hiding? Come out and fight me!
Smoke won't save you from me.
A log. Of course. Show yourself!
Cheap trick. Very cheap.
Last one to land a hit buys the ramen!
Stay where I can see you. All of you.
Three of them. Two kunai each, one smoke bomb left. Plan accordingly.
Hm. Let's be done quickly.
Come on! I'm right here! Hit me if you can!
You call that a stance? Our Academy first-years stand straighter.
I'm... I'm okay. Mostly okay. Keep going.
I'm hurt. It changes nothing. Keep to the plan.
Hey! You'll pay for that! Every bit of it!
Oh no. Hold on, I'm coming. Please hold on.
Yes! Did you see that? We were amazing!
Adequate. Your guard dropped twice. We'll drill it tonight.
That was the best! Again! Can we do it again?
Done. Nothing broken, nothing lost. A good day's work.
We lost the fight, not the mission. Get up. We go again.
Come here, let me look at that scrape. We'll be all right.
Now, now, NOW! All together!
On my count. Three beats. Strike on the third.
Shh, it's all right. Let me wrap it. There we are.
Hold still. If you'd blocked, I wouldn't need to do this.
Nobody gets near you. You have my word.
Okay. Right behind you. Don't go too fast?
Don't hold back. I'd know.
Is that your new move? I've seen it already.
Get up! I won't let them think our team is weak!
You took my teammate down? Then I'll take you down.
Not... over...
Write that one down. Rival: one. You: zero.
Three hits. You didn't block one.
I'm not running. I'm choosing a better day.
Purse on the ground, and nobody gets bruised.
Wrong road, traveller. This stretch has a toll.
Everyone up! We've got company!
That headband won't keep your coin in your pocket.
A Leaf ninja, way out here? Rush them before they make signs!
Spread out and circle round. Easy pickings.
Nobody passes the old cedar without paying. Nobody.
Look at all those shiny tools. I'll take the pouch first.
Run home, kid. This road's for grown-ups with money.
They sent a kid? The Leaf must be short of ninja.
Is that all the Academy teaches these days?
Come on, swing! My grandmother hits harder.
You fight like a scarecrow in a gale.
Tired yet? We've got all afternoon.
Three of us, one of you. Do the sums.
Nice kunai. Shame you can't aim it.
Keep dancing. You'll trip sooner or later.
I've robbed tougher merchants than you before breakfast.
Shouldn't you be in a classroom, kid?
Does your teacher know you're out this late?
Ow! Nobody said the Leaf ones bite!
This isn't worth my cut. It really isn't.
My ribs... somebody cover me!
Back off, back off! I need a breath!
I'm seeing two of you. Stop that.
That's it. I'm charging double for this job.
They flattened our biggest one!
Get up, you lump! We're losing!
Hey! That was my cousin!
One down already? Who taught you to fight like that?
Somebody drag them out of the ditch!
Now it's personal. Mostly about money, but also personal.
Should've... stayed a farmer...
Tell my mother... I was robbing politely...
The stars are... very pretty from down here...
Not the face... not the...
I'll just... lie here a bit...
Worst. Ambush. Ever.
All right, all right! I give!
Enough! I'm done, I'm done!
You win! Just stop hitting me!
I yield! See? Hands empty, nothing up my sleeves!
Truce! Truce! I know when I'm beaten.
Take the purse! Take all of it! It wasn't even ours!
We'll come quietly. Just don't hand us to the Uchiha police.
The stolen crates are in the barn by the creek. Honest.
Tie us up if you must, but loosely? My wrists bruise.
We surrender. Can we at least keep our sandals?
Fine, we'll walk to the village. Is there food in your cells?
Here. The cart, the mule, the lot. We're out of business.
Every bandit for themselves!
Run! The pay's not worth this!
Scatter! Meet at the old mill!
I left the stew on! Bye!
Not today! Not ever, actually!
Retreat! I mean, advance in the other direction!
Ha! Down they go. Check the pouch.
Who's laughing now, Leaf?
Leave them by the road. Someone'll find them.
Easy money. Told you it'd be easy money.
And that's why you pay the toll.
Wait till the others hear we beat a ninja!
My head. What happened? Where's everyone?
I'm going straight. Farming. Fishing. Anything.
Nobody tells the others about this. Nobody.
Lost to a Leaf ninja. My old gang will never let me forget it.
Can we talk this over? Tea? You're paying?
Beaten by a kid half my size. I'm retiring.
Ha! Saw that coming a mile off!
Blocked! Street fighting beats school fighting.
Nice try. I've been hit by better.
Too slow! Even with a club I'm faster.
Nope! Not today, ninja.
Ow, my wrist! How did you—
Hey! You're supposed to get hit!
My club went... where did my club go?
Argh! It's like hitting a wall!
That's cheating! Ninja cheating!
And stay down!
That's how we do it on the north road!
Ha! Right in the middle!
Like splitting firewood!
Bet that rang your bell!
My one trick: {technique}! Paid good ryo to learn it!
Watch this! {technique}! I practised all winter!
Whoa, {technique}?! Nobody said they'd use {technique}!
That's {technique}! Duck!
Hand signs! Stop them doing the hand signs!
Ninja tricks! Cover your eyes!
My trick! You broke my only trick!
That took me a whole winter to learn!
The fellow who sold me that swore it never fails.
Countered? What does countered even mean?
Five years of practice, gone in a puff.
Why is the road melting?
Snakes! Snakes everywhere!
Mother? What are you doing out here?
Is the sky supposed to be purple?
The trees are whispering about my debts!
Hah! Wasn't real! I knew it wasn't real!
Shook it off. Nice try with the snakes.
I bit my tongue and the trees stopped talking. Good.
My head's clear now. Yours is next.
Cough! Where'd they go?
I can't see a thing! Who's that? Is that you?
Don't swing, it might be me!
Smoke! The sneak used smoke!
Fan it away! Somebody fan it away!
Hold your breath and spread out!
A log?! I just punched a log!
Where did they... oh. It's a log. It's always a log.
Splinters! I've got splinters!
I hit them! I swear I hit... a stump.
Not the log trick again!
Hold it right there! This is a robbery. A polite one, if you behave.
The boss said nobody'd come. The boss is always wrong.
Your sandals are untied. Made you look!
Hit me, then! I've been hit by doors harder than you.
I want my mother. I want my mother's cooking, anyway.
Who said ninja were small and harmless? Who?
Wake up! You owe me three ryo!
I see... a big bowl of noodles... coming for me...
Good night... road... good night... cart...
I give up! I was only in it for the snacks anyway!
Stop! I'll go home! I'll even write to my aunt!
We'll give back the rice! Most of it! We ate a bit.
No more toll roads, we swear. We'll take up basket weaving.
Feet, don't fail me now!
Into the bushes! No, the other bushes!
Not so tough without your team, eh?
Grab the pouch and go before the rest of them turn up!
Ugh. Is it morning? Why am I tied to a tree?
Fine. You win. Tell the guards I was the nice one.
Ha! Twenty years of bar fights, ninja!
My arm's gone numb! Is that normal?
Ha! Didn't see that coming, did you?
Run! They're doing {technique}! I hate {technique}!
Not fair! You're not supposed to know the counter!
Why's my club turned into a fish?
I'm floating! Help! Or don't, it's quite nice.
The fish is a club again. Good. Very good.
Who stepped on my foot? Was that you?
I've been fighting a log for a whole minute!
That log is wearing their jacket! How?!
Ha! You call that a kick? My mule kicks harder.
I'm a lover of peace! Peace and running away!
Rope! Get the rope! Wait, who brought the rope?
Get back! They're fighting in the street!
Somebody fetch the police! Quick!
Mind the fruit stall! Not the fruit stall!
Inside, everyone! Shut the shutters!
Here we go again. Third time this month.
Someone run to the guard post at the gate!
Clear the bridge! Give them room!
Whoa! A real fight! Everyone come look!
Go get my big sister! She's a Genin!
Go on! Show them out of the village!
Don't let them push you around!
Teach that troublemaker some manners!
That's it! Give them a taste of the Leaf!
You can take them! I've seen you train!
Out of our market, you rascal!
Get 'em! Get 'em!
Do the thing with the hand signs!
They're hurt! Someone help!
Hold on! Help is coming!
Fall back! Nobody needs to be a hero today!
Run to the hospital, somebody! Now!
Careful! Watch your left!
Please, get out of there!
They knocked out the dango seller!
Get them off the street before they're trampled!
Drag them into the doorway! Gently!
Is anyone a medic? Anyone?
Oh no, not the old gate guard!
Fan them, quickly! They're coming round, I think.
Ooh... my head...
I only came out for tofu...
Tell the shop... I'll be late...
Everything's... spinning...
Run! Run!
Not my shop! Not again!
Grab the children and go!
I'm too old for this! Out of my way!
I'll be in the cellar if anyone needs me!
Leave the cart, just go!
Mama! Wait for me!
Hide behind the rain barrel!
They did it! They really did it!
Three cheers for our ninja!
That's the Leaf for you!
Somebody get that one a bowl of ramen!
I knew it! Didn't I say they'd win?
Well fought! Wait till the whole street hears!
That was the coolest thing I've ever seen!
I'm gonna be a ninja too! Just like that!
No! Get up! Please get up!
Somebody help them!
Fetch a medic! And the police!
Don't move them! Wait for help!
Shame on you! Picking on our own!
They gave up! Good riddance!
Tie them up before they change their mind!
Hands where we can see them, troublemaker!
That's right! Nobody wins against the Leaf!
Did you see that? Blocked it clean!
What a catch!
Ha! Turned it right back!
Such quick hands!
Ooh! That one landed!
That'll leave a mark!
Bang! Right on the mark!
One, two, three! Beautiful!
Was that {technique}? Right here on the street?
Everybody down! It's {technique}!
{technique}! Like the stories!
Not near the paper lanterns! Not {technique}!
Hand signs! Stand back, it's a jutsu!
{technique}! I saw {technique}! Wait till class hears!
Why are there two moons?
The street's tilting! Is the street tilting?
Did that lantern just wink at me?
Cough! What's that smell?
Smoke! Get the water buckets!
Open the windows! I can't see the counter!
Is it fire? Tell me it's not fire!
Where did that log come from?
They turned into a log! A whole log!
Ha! That troublemaker's punching firewood!
Look, a log! The oldest trick there is!
Not in front of the bathhouse! Take it to the training grounds!
Grab the laundry off the line, it's a fight!
Go on, ninja! Make the street proud!
Watch out for the rain barrel, it's new!
Someone fetch water for them! And a bandage!
Stay back from the edge, dear! Mind the canal!
They knocked over the noodle cart! And the cook!
Carry them to the clinic, gently now!
Who put... the ground... up here?
Take the back lane! Behind the tofu shop!
Save the pickles! Save the pickles!
Free dango at my stall for the hero!
I'll tell my grandchildren about this one.
Fetch the Jonin! Anyone in a flak vest!
Leave our ninja alone, you brute!
Look at that troublemaker beg! Good!
Like a cat batting a fly!
Down they go! Mind my potted plants!
Careful with {technique}! My roof is thatch!
Why is the fishmonger's sign singing?
My laundry! It'll smell of smoke for a week!
They hit a log! Good, that troublemaker can split my firewood next!
Don't give up! Please don't give up!
Whoa! Did you see that block?
Ninja smoke! It smells like fireworks!
A log! Teach me how to do the log thing!
Get up! You can't lose! You're a ninja!
The dango lady fell over! Somebody help her!
Pow! Right in the tummy!
They gave up! We win! The Leaf wins!
The ground's all wiggly! Is this a jutsu?
Sorry, but only one of us gets through this round.
Hand over your scroll and nobody has to lose.
Our team trained a whole year for this. Move!
I've watched your matches. I know your moves.
Nothing personal. My sensei is watching.
Ready? I won't go easy just because we're the same rank.
Your team's down a member? Then this is our chance!
You're not making it to the finals like that.
Is that your best? The proctors look bored.
Our sensei said your team would be easy.
Keep swinging. You'll hit something eventually.
Even the crowd's yawning!
You're shaking. Nervous? Me neither.
I can't lose here. Not in front of everyone.
Just a little longer. Come on, legs!
Ugh. This isn't how I practised it.
I can still go! Proctor, I can still go!
Hold it together... hold it together...
No! Get up! We need three to pass!
Hang on, I'm coming!
You'll pay for that! That's my teammate!
Stay down, I'll cover you!
Two of us left. We can still do this.
Sorry... everyone...
Not... yet... I wasn't done...
Tell my team... I'll make it up to them...
Next year... next year for sure...
Proctor! I forfeit! I can't go on.
I give up! You're too strong for me.
Fine, take the scroll! Just let us go!
Enough. You win this one. Fair and square.
Fall back! Regroup at the river!
Not worth it! We'll find an easier team!
Run! We still have time to find another scroll!
Retreat! We live to take the exam another day!
Yes! We're through!
Did you see that, sensei? Did you see?
That's our scroll now. Sorry.
Ha! The finals, here we come!
We did it! All those mornings at the training ground paid off!
We lost. After all that training.
You earned it. Go win the whole thing.
I'll be back next exam. Stronger.
Our sensei is going to be so disappointed.
Good fight. Really. I mean that.
Blocked! I knew it!
Too obvious!
Our sensei drilled us on that!
Ha! Not this time!
How did you read that?
No way! That always works!
Argh, my timing!
Your team trains on parries too?
Got you! Right in front of the proctor!
That's for my team!
The full chain! Just like we practised!
Down you go! Next round's mine!
Watch this! {technique}!
My secret weapon: {technique}!
I've been saving {technique} for the finals, but fine!
{technique}! Our team's best move!
Hand signs, fast! {technique}!
Countered?! That took me months!
How do you know how to stop that?
My best jutsu... gone, just like that.
I'll need something new for the finals.
Wait, is that real? Is the forest moving?
The proctor just turned into a frog!
Where did my team go? Everyone?
Release! I won't fall for that twice!
Broke it! Our sensei taught us that!
Ha! Not even close!
Smoke! Find them! Spread out!
Watch the trees, they went up!
Don't lose them! They've got the scroll!
Cough! Not fair!
A log? Again?!
Substitution! I should have seen that!
They're behind us! Turn around!
Great. I just beat up a tree in front of everyone.
We've been tracking your team for an hour. Hand it over.
The finals are only three days away. Out of my way!
Your team's scattered. Ours isn't.
The proctor's watching. Try not to embarrass yourself.
I won't go home with nothing! I won't!
Leave them alone! They've done nothing to you!
My village... was watching...
Stop! I give up! You've won the round!
Scatter! Meet at the big tree with the red rope!
Two scrolls! We're going to the tower!
Did you see that? We beat a Leaf team!
Next time, I'll be ready for you.
Our team will come back stronger. Remember us.
I knew you'd try that! Saw it in the prelims!
You're quicker than you looked in the first round.
That's what three mornings a week of drills looks like!
{technique}! Win or lose, I'm giving it everything!
Did the proctor see that? Tell me they didn't see that.
The scroll's talking to me. Scrolls don't talk.
Not real! Nice try, but not real!
Form a circle! Back to back!
I threw everything at a log. My sensei is going to laugh at me.
We've got your scroll's twin. We just need yours.
Sorry. You fought well. But we need this more.
My sensei said never quit. My legs disagree.
Ow! Did the proctor see me get parried? Tell me no.
Go on, then. Win it for both of us.
A Leaf headband. I used to wear one of those, from somewhere else.
Turn around and I'll forget I saw you.
Your village sent you to fetch me? How thrifty.
I'm paid by the job, not the hour. Let's be quick.
Rules, ranks, missions. I gave all that up. Show me what it bought you.
You've been trained well. Not well enough.
Let's see what the Leaf teaches its young ones now.
You telegraph everything. Your sensei should be ashamed.
Breathe through your nose. You're wasting chakra.
I could do this with my eyes shut. Shall I?
Every swing, the same shoulder drops first.
You fight like someone who has never lost. That ends today.
Hesitating? Out here, hesitation costs.
Your footwork is pure Academy. Charming.
Tch. Sharper than you look.
Fine. No more holding back.
I've had worse from better.
You'll pay for every one of these bruises.
Time to stop playing fair.
Careless of me. It won't happen twice.
Hired help. Never worth the coin.
Useless. I'll finish this myself.
One fewer share of the pay. I can live with that.
Get up. I'm not carrying you.
You took that one down cleanly. I'm almost impressed.
Beaten by... a village pup...
Should have taken... the other job...
The Leaf... still turns them out sharp...
So this is... what it feels like... to lose...
Enough. You've made your point.
I know when a fight's gone. Take me in, then.
Put it away. I won't run.
You win. Don't expect me to say it twice.
Another day, Leaf.
Not worth it. Not for this pay.
I'll remember your face.
This contract just expired.
A smart rogue knows when to leave.
Go home. Tell them who taught you a lesson.
Lie there a while and think about your footwork.
Stay down. It's the first wise thing you've done.
Train harder. Then come looking.
Tell your village to send someone better next time.
Tie the knots tighter. I've slipped looser ones.
Your Hokage will want to talk. I've nothing to say.
Quick hands. Whoever trained you knew the work.
I left my village to be free. Look how that turned out.
Predictable.
I saw that before you did.
Again? You never learn.
That trick is older than you are.
Too eager. Wait for the opening.
Hm. Good timing.
So you can read a strike. Interesting.
Lucky. Do it again and I'll worry.
Not bad. Your teacher earned their pay.
Down you go.
That's how it's done.
Lesson over.
Keep your guard up next time. If there is one.
Feel that? That's experience.
{technique}. Dodge if you can.
Let's see you handle {technique}.
I learned {technique} long before you could walk.
{technique}! This ends now.
Watch my hands. It won't help.
You know {technique}? No? Here's your first lesson.
Countered? Someone taught you properly.
Clever. I'll use something you haven't read about.
Tch. I wasted good chakra on that.
So the Leaf still teaches the old counters.
An illusion? Insulting.
Clumsy work. I can see the seams.
What is this... no. Not real.
Hm. Something's wrong with the light.
Release. You'll need a better illusion than that.
Broken. Try something real.
I've slipped out of finer genjutsu than yours.
A pinch of pain clears any fog.
Smoke. How very Academy of you.
Hiding won't save you. I'll hear your feet.
Run, then. The road only goes so far.
Clever. I'll find you before it clears.
Listen for them. Smoke can't hide breathing.
A log. I should have known.
Substitution. Old trick, still works. Annoying.
Wasted a good strike on firewood.
Where... behind me? Hm.
Fine. You get one of those. I get the rest.
This road is mine for the week. You're trespassing.
I know your village's drills. I've broken every one of them.
You're breathing hard. I've barely started.
Is the Leaf still teaching the three-strike chain? Yes. I see it is.
Your hand signs are pretty. Too slow, though.
You hit like a Chunin. Annoying.
I didn't come this far to fall to a Genin.
Cheap mercenaries. You get what you pay for.
Not... like this... not to the Leaf...
I'm out of chakra and out of patience. You win.
I don't fight for free. Goodbye.
Keep your scroll. I'll take my life on the road instead.
Tie that one to a tree. Their village can come fetch them.
Not bad. In a few years you might be worth hunting.
I trained as hard as you once. Somewhere it went wrong.
No more running, then. Take me in.
You strike exactly where you look.
I've not been parried since I left home.
Every opening you leave, I'll take.
You'll never see {technique} in a classroom.
That counter is new. Who's teaching in the Leaf now?
Someone in your squad has a gift for illusions. Pity.
Out. That cost you more chakra than it cost me.
Fine. Hide. I've hunted in worse fog than this.
I cut a log in half. Well done, Leaf.
Go back to your village. Tell them the road isn't theirs.
I used to be someone's student too. I learned faster.
That one landed. Don't get used to it.
The same jutsu three times running? By the third, anyone worth fighting has a counter ready.
A technique is a word, not a sentence. Mix it with throws and footwork so it lands as a surprise.
You leaned on one jutsu the whole fight. Learn a second, even a small one, and they'll never settle.
Watch their face the next time you cast it twice. They stop flinching. That's your cue to change.
You never once raised your hands. Blocking costs you nothing but a moment, and it halves the hurt.
Attack is half the work. Hold your guard while you wait for an opening, not after you've been hit.
Your opponent swung freely because you let them. Raise a block and make them think twice.
If you can't dodge it, block it. If you block it at the last instant, you can turn it right back.
You stood and took every hit. A quick dash to the side would have spared you most of them.
